recent.text: A welcome sight from the Wizards' fans here in Capital One Arena: After Anthony Davis scored from 11 feet to cut Washington's deficit to 117-108, a lot of fans here rose to their feet. After a Boston miss, Kyshawn George scored, and now there's lots of life back in the building.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: Where would the Wizards be in this game if not for Anthony Davis? Probably a blowout. Davis has 10 of Washington's 28 points. At the end of the first quarter, the Celtics lead the Wizards 34-28.

recent.text: The Wizards have extended their lead to 103-81 after Bilal Coulibaly sank his fourth triple of the game. The Magic entered this game willing to have Coulibaly take lots of 3s, but Coulibaly has found his rhythm tonight. He entered today 6-of-36 from deep (17%).
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: Bilal Coulibaly has made two of the three 3-pointers he's attempted in the first quarter. It's the first time all season that he's made two triples in a single game.
recent.author: Josh Robbins
